summary: Open the assigned Catalog image from the mobile item avatar or open Images when the avatar is empty and the merchant can edit.
noAssistantImpact: The avatar reuses the existing authorized photo preview and Images editor. Catalog commands, permission checks and assistant capabilities are unchanged.

evidence.result: Android 2 opened Images from an empty avatar and showed an assigned illustration in the read-only viewer. A saved photo opened the viewer and hit the existing image-load error. Mobile TypeScript and 203 scoped smoke tests passed.
